provenance: veg-palette-mc2_01 lane, 2026-11-10. Stock foliage swatches: 15/50/85th percentile of green-dominant pixels in the stock palm crown and the hill treeline of the owner_lowwide_zoom capture. Species ramps are hand-picked from these swatches (screen-space, lit colours); the vegetation shader exposes cards by ground luma / ground_luma.
